sentryTest.hint: Throws a test error to verify error reporting. Remove this section when you are done.

enrichment.title: Image Enrichment
enrichment.description: Batch-add illustrations to exercises that don't have one yet.
enrichment.allDoneHint: Nothing left in the queue — nice work.

translations.title: Translation Review
translations.description: Compare the French source with its English translation, sentence by sentence — flagged rows first.
translations.allDoneHint: Every translated exercise has been read — nice work.
translations.editSection: Edit the English for {{section}} — one sentence per line
translations.cardLabel: Reviewing {{name}} — press A to approve, E to edit, R to revert to French, arrow right to skip
translations.cardLabelEditing: Editing the English for {{name}} — press Escape to discard the correction
translations.orphanObjections_one: {{count}} objection points at a sentence that does not exist and is not shown below.
translations.orphanObjections_other: {{count}} objections point at sentences that do not exist and are not shown below.

audit.line: Translated by {{model}} on {{date}} · cross-checked by {{checker}} · prompt v{{version}}

assist.title: Adjudicate with an assistant
assist.description: Copy the request, hand it to an assistant, then paste its corrected JSON back here. Nothing is written until you have read the diff.
assist.copied: Adjudication request copied to the clipboard
assist.copyFailed: Could not reach the clipboard — copy the request from this message

problem.unreadable: That is not valid JSON. Copy the assistant's whole reply, braces included, and paste it again.
problem.shape: That JSON is not an instruction block. It needs the four keys — setup, movement, breathing, common_mistakes — each holding a list of sentences. Ask the assistant to reply with the block and nothing else.
problem.blanked: That correction leaves {{sections}} empty while the French has sentences there. The exercise would be shown in French despite being approved — ask the assistant for the complete block.
problem.empty: That correction has no sentence left in it.

toast.error: Decision not saved — the exercise stays in the queue
toast.refused: Decision refused — your account may no longer have review access

review.title: Exercise Review
review.description: Review and validate exercise content — sorted by most used first.
review.allDoneHint: Nothing left to review — great job.
review.importJsonHint: Paste the corrected JSON from the LLM here. It will pre-fill the form — review then save.
review.importParseError: Invalid JSON — check the pasted content

exercisesDescription: Manage exercise content — instructions, videos, images

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.description: Review and resolve user-submitted exercise content feedback
